description:
## Compatibility hotfix

- Uses the range-form invoke instruction for the Cronet engine hook so YouTube
  methods returning registers above `v15` patch without an invalid-register
  warning.
- Adds the missing Russian translation for the message shown when Yandex voice
  translation is requested on a live stream.

## Validation

- 80 YouTube unit tests passed with zero failures or errors.
- The Android patch bundle and Manager metadata generated successfully.
